name: Sam Perkins
current_role: Co-founder & COO, Nourish (telehealth nutrition / registered dietitians)
profile: Princeton alum who co-founded Nourish with childhood friend Aidan Dewar (CEO) and Stephanie Liu (CTO). Nourish connects patients with registered dietitians via insurance-covered telehealth; 94% of patients pay $0 out of pocket, it has 10,000+ dietitians in all 50 states, and it reached a ~$2B valuation after large 2025-26 rounds ($70M Series B, $100M raise).
interesting_fact: Nourish says 500k+ people have been helped by its dietitians, and it is backed by founders of Headway, Spring Health, Oscar, Notion and Flatiron among others.
deep_cut_fact: Nourish is a friendship company: Perkins and CEO Aidan Dewar are childhood friends, and CTO Stephanie Liu became close friends with Perkins at Princeton before the three co-founded it.
notes: Nourish's public face is CEO Aidan Dewar (Forbes 30 Under 30; Wharton Pulse podcast). TechCrunch notes the founders' personal motivations - avoid health specifics in outreach. No press email published on site (only support@).

name: Isaac Turner
profile: Computational biologist (PhD in Bioinformatics, Oxford) who co-founded Curative in 2020 with Fred Turner and Vlad Slepnev. After running mass COVID-19 testing, Curative pivoted to a vertically integrated $0 out-of-pocket health plan; Isaac leads its technology, including a proprietary 'first principles' insurance stack, the Curative Cash Card and AI-driven care navigation.
interesting_fact: Curative describes itself as the nation's first vertically integrated, $0 out-of-pocket health insurance plan, built on its own insurance software stack.
deep_cut_fact: He trained as a computational biologist with a PhD in Bioinformatics from Oxford before turning to building health-insurance software, and spoke with Cell Systems in 2020 about COVID testing at scale.
notes: Co-founder with Fred Turner (CEO, lane 083). Cell Systems interview: https://www.cell.com/action/showPdf?pii=S2405-4712(20)30367-7 (via Wikipedia citation). No press email found.

name: Abraham Burak
profile: Toronto-based Canadian co-founder of Airalo, the eSIM marketplace he launched in 2019 with Bahadir Ozdemir. Airalo sells travel eSIMs for 200+ destinations, passed 20 million users in 2025 and hit unicorn status with a $220M CVC-led Series C. Burak runs operations and is often the company's spokesperson.
interesting_fact: Airalo's growth 'stalled' for two years during the pandemic before exploding as travel returned - 'We are seeing exponential growth in signups because travel is picking up,' Burak told TechCrunch in 2023.
deep_cut_fact: He studied at law schools around the world - in China, Switzerland and the Netherlands - then entered the University of Ottawa's law program, which he left to launch Airalo.
notes: More press-facing than CEO Ozdemir; quoted regularly. No press email found (airalo.com blocks automated fetches).
